User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the PDF Spark application. Authentication is handled externally, so this entity primarily stores user identification and role information within the application context.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity. This ID is typically provided by an external authentication system.

email.description: The user's email address, used for identification and communication.

role.description: The role assigned to the user within the application, such as 'admin', 'worker', or 'standard'.

creationDateTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the user's record was created in the system.

status.description: The current status of the user account.

File.title: File
File.description: Represents a PDF or other document file uploaded by a user or generated by an operation. This entity stores metadata about the file and its storage location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the File entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns or uploaded this file. (Relationship: User 1:N File)

originalFileName.description: The original name of the file when it was uploaded by the user.

storedFileName.description: The system-generated name for the file as it is stored in the backend (e.g., a UUID).

storagePath.description: The path or URL where the file is physically stored in the cloud storage or file system.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document').

fileSize.description: The size of the file in bytes.

uploadDateTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the file was uploaded.

status.description: The current status of the file (e.g., 'uploaded', 'processing', 'processed', 'deleted', 'temporary').

Operation.title: Operation
Operation.description: Records details of each PDF processing operation performed by a user, including merge, split, conversion, and AI analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Operation entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who initiated this operation. (Relationship: User 1:N Operation)

operationType.description: The type of PDF operation performed (e.g., 'merge', 'split', 'convert', 'ai_analysis').

status.description: The current status of the operation (e.g., 'pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed').
